purpose: Outcome-free timing diagnosis and instrumentation challenge, not strength or historical replay rehabilitation.
actors: Exact frozen native build74 core/UCI baseline and build76 BOUNDARY2 runtime from verified SR034 bindings; unchanged policy, payload, heap, workers and JVM ergonomics.
inputs: Two published adverse-request full histories, then first12 existing SR002 confirmation-corpus histories. These are diagnostic/development roots, never fresh strength evidence. No historical PGN, score or result is opened.
cases: Each process:14 deterministic100000-node controls, then14 roots x clocks[9799,2933,500,150,51,50]ms, increment100/default30. New game and isready before every request. Legal PV, accounting, consecutive completed depths and post-request fence; shutdown and owned drain required.
instrumentation: On uses unchanged JDK21 default JFR plus unified gc/safepoint logs with UTC/uptimenanos. All processes capture external send-to-bestmove wall time and native process CPU before/after; raw request transcript retained. No per-node instrumentation or algorithm change. JFR events can explain JVM pauses/waits, not directly certify OS runnable preemption.
challenge: Instrumentation must preserve exact node-control moves/scores/PV/node signatures. Compare paired fixed-node elapsed/processCPU costs and timed tails with instrument off/on, in balanced temporal order. A descriptive median elapsed ratio outside .95..1.05 warrants investigation before using instrumented timing as neutral; small samples cannot certify equivalence. Timed tree identity is not expected.
resources: 30s idle admission <=2 other average logical cores and memory>=8GiB/load<=75%; serial owned job, 15min watchdog. No overlapping builds/tests/games. Record host interval and native lifetime CPU; timing conclusions require resource qualification. Failure cannot be hidden by rerunning the same name.
analysis: Report legal/lifecycle checks, complete request and external tail, native CPU, pause duration and request/deadline overlap. Retain all >25ms events under historical threshold as diagnostic witnesses only. No causal attribution from association alone; no score analysis or qualification-rule change.
nextGate: Inspect evidence before choosing any follow-up diagnostic or prospective strength protocol. Inadequate discrimination calls for targeted measurement, not a speculative engine fix.
